executive_summary: The web application at the target URL has passed all smoke and functional tests, indicating basic functionality is intact. However, several critical and high-severity security issues were identified, primarily due to missing security headers, which could expose the application to various vulnerabilities.

ai_issues.title: Missing HSTS header
ai_issues.root_cause: The HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) header is not set, which is crucial for enforcing secure connections.
ai_issues.business_impact: Without HSTS, users may be vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks, potentially compromising sensitive data.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Implement the HSTS header to ensure all communications are over HTTPS.

ai_issues.title: Missing CSP header
ai_issues.root_cause: The Content Security Policy (CSP) header is missing, which helps prevent cross-site scripting and other code injection attacks.
ai_issues.business_impact: Lack of CSP can lead to unauthorized script execution, compromising user data and application integrity.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Add a CSP header to define and enforce content policies.

ai_issues.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
ai_issues.root_cause: The X-Content-Type-Options header is not set, which prevents MIME type sniffing.
ai_issues.business_impact: Without this header, browsers may interpret files as a different MIME type, leading to security vulnerabilities.

ai_issues.title: Missing X-Frame-Options header
ai_issues.root_cause: The X-Frame-Options header is absent, which is used to protect against clickjacking attacks.
ai_issues.business_impact: Without this header, the application may be embedded in iframes, leading to potential clickjacking attacks.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Add the X-Frame-Options header with a value of 'DENY' or 'SAMEORIGIN'.

ai_issues.title: Missing Referrer-Policy header
ai_issues.root_cause: The Referrer-Policy header is missing, which controls the amount of referrer information sent with requests.
ai_issues.business_impact: Lack of this header may lead to leakage of sensitive URL information.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Implement a Referrer-Policy header to control referrer information.

ai_issues.title: Missing Permissions-Policy header
ai_issues.root_cause: The Permissions-Policy header is not set, which helps control which features and APIs can be used in the browser.
ai_issues.business_impact: Without this header, there is less control over browser features, potentially leading to misuse.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Add a Permissions-Policy header to restrict the use of browser features.

positive_findings: All smoke tests passed successfully, indicating that the application is up and running.
All functional tests passed, confirming that the core functionalities are working as expected.
No performance issues were detected, with an average response time of 448ms.
No visual issues were found during testing.
